niche_preference_profile: Prefers calm, polished interfaces with soft light backgrounds, muted or controlled color, clear information hierarchy, and layouts that feel intentional rather than noisy. They consistently like complete, well-structured settings and onboarding flows with good spacing, restrained surfaces, and simple focused actions. They often favor conversational but composed UX, subtle containment, and modern app-like polish over harsh contrast, fragmented modules, or visually aggressive treatment.

criteria.description: Prefers light, airy, low-contrast presentation with gentle surfaces and reduced visual heaviness rather than dark, harsh, or high-contrast UI.
Prefers orderly top-to-bottom hierarchy with clearly separated sections, strong grouping, and scannable organization rather than fragmented or competing content blocks.
Prefers restrained, mature, polished UI with less decorative noise, fewer attention-grabbing elements, and more controlled emphasis.
Prefers screens that feel fully populated, comprehensive, and purposefully specified rather than sparse, unfinished, or underdeveloped.
Prefers generous spacing, balanced vertical rhythm, and layouts with breathing room rather than crowded, compressed stacking.
Prefers straightforward, uniform interaction patterns such as clean toggle rows and consistent row treatments rather than mixed control types or overly complex selectors.
